title: eat shit & die 180
author: bpatrick
body:
Thanks to Jonny Paycheck for keeping me on track! This one made me laugh when I thought of it. It kind of surprised me. Next week is the last week of finals and then: Summer of Comics!

A big thank you to Winston Rountree for recommending akimbo in an interview here (and here) and if you’re not already an avid fan of subnormality then I can’t do anything for you.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: Ha, so many pigs… This is why i mention you in interviews!

comments.author: ignorance
comments.text: Haha love it, glad Winston recommended your work, it’s amazing stuff. Good luck with your finals!

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text: I’m here because of that recommendation and am seriously digging this comic, thanks man, keep it up!

comments.author: Evan B.
comments.text: This is one of my favorites so far.

comments.author: rajit
comments.text: haha good on you for making fun of the welfare system

comments.author: WolffBrosef2
comments.text: so true. sometimes it’s just a waste of time to try to convince the foolish pigs of this world to change…

comments.author: Rolan
comments.text: Pigs dont roll in shit if they can help it, i think. They do roll around in mud though.
